action.objective: Advance the a-pawn to gain space and create a passed-pawn threat, keeping the rook on f5 and king on h2 safe.
action.rationale: a3a4 is the only commit_ready move: exact depth-4 score 918, complete safety probe (no mating reply, tactical_refutation not_found, only Rxh4+ check manageable). King on h2 is not in danger; rook f5 stays active and bishop b4 controls the a5-e1 diagonal. Broad depth-3 alternatives (Bf8, Ba5) were upper bounds, not safe ties, and remain unverified. Advancing the pawn is solid and preserves the position.
